Requests 60fps for supported standard photo previews. Saved photo settings are preserved; native limits apply to unsupported streams and high temperatures.
Adds Samsung-supported 120 fps recording choices to normal Video mode. Pro Video remains unchanged.

120 fps is limited to resolutions and lenses supported by the camera pipeline. This build targets rear FHD and UHD. 8K, HD, front cameras and special aspect ratios are not added without a supported recording path.
Animates lens field of view and hands off to the new live preview. Open Samsung Camera once after updating to use its zoom curves and timing. An unavailable preview falls back to normal switching.
Applies to lens changes. Existing front/rear and resolution animations keep their native behavior.
Camera Assistant and this app share the same switches. After changing Camera settings, force stop Camera and open it again to refresh its recording choices. Finish any recording or capture first.

Enable this module in Vector for Camera, Camera Assistant and Expert RAW. Add SystemUI for the Quick Panel light. For additional Camera2 lenses, also select each camera app you use. Force-stop and reopen the affected apps after installing or updating. Reload SystemUI after its first activation or module update.

Experimental support: Galaxy S26 Ultra (SM-S948Q), Android 17 / One UI 9 BZI9; Camera 17.0.00.43, Camera Assistant 5.0.00.7, Expert RAW 6.0.02.8. Other versions keep their original behavior. Requires an API 102 compatible framework.
Not loaded yet. Open the corresponding app after enabling the module.
Three confirmed crashes within two minutes after module operations stop changes in that app. Normal process restarts do not count. Reset protection and force stop/reopen the affected app to retry.
Use light with the ultra-wide lens
Allows Samsung Camera’s flash and video light with the rear ultra-wide lens. Native temperature and camera protections remain active. Force stop and reopen Camera after changing this option.
Keeps the focus distance measured just before the flash through the photo. Autofocus resumes after capture, cancellation or leaving Camera. Focus again before shooting when the subject moves.
Routes the Quick Panel flashlight to Samsung Camera while its rear preview is available. The light turns off when leaving Camera. Existing temperature and battery protections still apply.

Makes supported additional rear camera IDs visible in ordinary camera apps selected in Vector. Enable the module for each camera app, then restart that app. Camera permission is still required. This does not add unsupported resolutions or frame rates, and apps may not offer a lens selector.
Eases photo and video lens changes, including Super Steady and horizontal lock. Slightly longer transitions make acceleration and deceleration easier to see.
